# Yearn Tutorials: Game Import, Controllers and Saves

> Prepare your own games and platform files, then check touch or physical controls, saves, offline play, display layouts and launch issues.

## App and version

- [Yearn: Retro Game Emulator for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/yearn/index.md): Learn about Yearn game imports, touch and physical controllers, save states, sync checks, display layouts and launch troubleshooting.
Version listed: 1.0.2; checked 2026-10-23; iOS 17.0+ / iPadOS 17.0+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Yearn getting started: import your own first game and exit safely](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-getting-started/index.md): Begin with a ROM you supply, then import it, confirm its platform, check controls, save manually and verify after exit for a clear first-use workflow. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [2. Yearn file recognition: distinguish platform formats and disc companion files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-rom-formats/index.md): Check ROM names, extensions, platforms and companion files, distinguishing single-file games, PS1 disc images and archives to reduce import mistakes. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [3. Yearn folder import: organise a batch of games and check omissions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-folder-import/index.md): Organise folders and matching filenames before importing, then verify each platform and sample, understanding the relationship between batch copies and original files. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [4. Yearn BIOS setup: check required files for each platform](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-bios-setup/index.md): Understand the different roles of ROM and BIOS, check required PS1 files and NDS status, retain source information and investigate missing-file messages after import. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [5. Organise the Yearn library: search, favourites, covers and recent games](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-library-organizing/index.md): Build a searchable imported-game list with platform filters, sorting, search and favourites, distinguishing cover images from runnable game files. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [6. Yearn virtual controller: adjust size, opacity and haptic feedback](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-virtual-controller/index.md): Compare virtual-controller size and opacity in a fixed game scene, checking portrait, landscape, directional and action buttons to find a comfortable grip layout. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [7. Yearn Bluetooth controller: pair and check button responses](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-bluetooth-controller/index.md): Pair the controller in iOS, then check recognition, directions and action buttons in Yearn, distinguishing system connection, app input and game response. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [8. Troubleshoot Yearn controller input: button positions, D-pad and stick dead zones](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-controller-input-check/index.md): Use a fixed scene to check physical-button positions and stick response, avoid mistaking different letter labels for faults, and adjust the dead zone in small steps. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [9. Yearn landscape and dual screens: give the game and controls their own space](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-landscape-layout/index.md): Use a safe game scene to check orientation, controller size and dual-screen content, distinguishing system rotation lock, device layout and the game’s original aspect ratio. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [10. Yearn speed controls: fast-forward through waits and slow down actions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-speed-control/index.md): Compare normal, fast and slow speed step by step, checking button actions, sound, picture and save state, and distinguish running speed from turbo-fire controls. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [11. Yearn save states: keep key progress in separate slots](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-save-slots/index.md): Distinguish Save from Load, record different scenes in two slots and verify loading in the same session and after reopening, avoiding overwriting your only progress. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [12. Yearn in-game saves and save states: verify that saved progress loads](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-autosave-battery/index.md): Distinguish the game’s own save menu from emulator states, test save, exit, reopen and load, and understand why autosave settings do not replace a restore check. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [13. Yearn iCloud save sync: check cloud status before switching devices](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-icloud-saves/index.md): Check iCloud availability and manual sync, distinguish copying cloud files from actually loading progress in a game, and keep verifiable local records before changing devices. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [14. Prepare Yearn for offline travel: games, BIOS and saves](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-offline-trip/index.md): Use airplane mode before travelling to check local games, required BIOS files, controllers and saves, separating online information and cloud placeholders from files that really run offline. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [15. Yearn storage cleanup: back up before deleting games and saves](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-backup-delete/index.md): Distinguish ROMs, save states, in-game saves and screenshots before cleanup, keep independent copies and confirm which data each deletion affects. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [16. Yearn screen size: adjust scaling, aspect ratio and margins](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-screen-size/index.md): Use circles, text and screen edges to judge display scaling, distinguishing useful enlargement, stretched proportions and controls obscuring the picture. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [17. Yearn on a TV: check picture and delay with iPhone screen mirroring](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-screen-mirroring/index.md): Use Apple’s system screen mirroring to show Yearn on a compatible TV, then check connection, orientation, audio and input delay separately. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [18. Import PS1 disc images into Yearn: CUE, BIN and multiple tracks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-ps1-disc-files/index.md): Organise PS1 disc images you lawfully hold, distinguish track descriptions from data files, and check filename references, companion imports and causes of launch failure. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [19. Yearn screenshots: save a game image and organise your records](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-screenshots/index.md): Save a game image in Yearn, confirm it in Photos, distinguish game captures from system screenshots and keep identifiable progress or troubleshooting records. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [20. Troubleshoot Yearn launch: from a successful import to a running game](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn-launch-troubleshooting/index.md): Separate launch failures into file, platform, BIOS, runtime and input stages, using small repeatable tests to identify what needs attention. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
